result.topic_en: Station adjustment of horizontal direction observations at the triangulation station Garlste (directions to Varel, Bremerlehe, Brillit and Bremen), with normal equations in the corrections a, b, c, d and the resulting adjusted angles with their residuals.

methods.what: Least-squares station adjustment of directions: unknown corrections a, b, c, d added to the observed directions
Normal equations for the direction corrections, with the angle weights (number of repetitions) as coefficients
Observation equations for the measured angles, written as weight, observed angle, residual and correction difference
Total count of observations split into old and new series
